clinicalSummary: Exertional chest tightness relieved by rest over three months, family history of early coronary disease, borderline hypertension.
Chronic scaly plaques on elbows and knees with nail pitting, partial response to topical steroids, suspected psoriasis.
Six weeks of bloody diarrhea, abdominal cramping and weight loss, raised inflammatory markers, query inflammatory bowel disease.
Recurrent unilateral throbbing headaches with aura and photophobia, three episodes a month, not controlled on simple analgesia.
Chronic right knee pain with locking and giving way after a sports injury, MRI shows a meniscal tear, failed physiotherapy.
Progressive exertional breathlessness and chronic productive cough in a long-term smoker, spirometry shows airflow obstruction.
Poorly controlled type 2 diabetes on maximal oral agents with HbA1c of 10.2%, needs insulin initiation and review.
Eight months of low mood, anhedonia, poor sleep and passive suicidal thoughts, inadequate response to two antidepressant trials.
Gradual painless loss of vision in both eyes with glare and difficulty driving at night, suspected cataracts.
Older man with weak urinary stream, nocturia and hesitancy, raised PSA on screening, enlarged prostate on exam.
Declining renal function with eGFR 28 and persistent proteinuria over six months, hypertension difficult to control.
Unilateral nasal obstruction with recurrent epistaxis and reduced sense of smell over three months in an adult.
